description: J201 low-pinch-off N-channel JFET (our model from Fairchild's and InterFET's sheets)

source.licence: Our own model built from the maker's data sheet (D-159, D-161): the values are Solum Builder's

package.name: TO-92 (DSG)
package.source: Fairchild J201/J202/MMBFJ201/MMBFJ202 data sheet (1997), page 1: leads drawn D, S, G, numbered 1-3 as onsemi's numbered TO-92 JFET sheets do (2N5457/D Style 5, MPF102/D: 1 drain, 2 source, 3 gate; D-154). InterFET's J201-2 sheet (IF35018.R00), which the validation cites, numbers its own units 1 source, 2 drain, 3 gate; the gate is pin 3 either way, and Fairchild calls source and drain interchangeable

fit.sheet: Fairchild J201/J202 data sheet (1997); InterFET J201/J202 data sheet IF35018.R00 (June 2019)
fit.figure: Electrical characteristics (no typical DC curve on the sheet)
fit.method: Idss and Vp the geometric middles of the sheets' ranges (0.2-1.0 mA, -0.3 to -1.5 V): 0.447 mA, -0.671 V; BETA = Idss/Vp²; LAMBDA from InterFET's typical output conductance, 1 µS / Idss; CGD = Crss 1 pF, CGS = Ciss − Crss = 3 pF (InterFET typical)
fit.note: Real units spread over the sheet's whole range; a circuit's measured Idss and Vp replace these (D-130)

datasheet.source: Fairchild J201/J202 data sheet (1997), Electrical Characteristics: IDSS at VDS = 20 V
Fairchild J201/J202 data sheet (1997), Electrical Characteristics: VGS(off) at VDS = 20 V, ID = 10 nA
